title: Antya-lila, chapter 15. The Lord’s Pastime in the Garden
html:
“Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta”
Antya-līlā
Chapter 15
The Lord’s Pastime in the Garden
(English translation from the Bengali, following the Gauḍīya Maṭha edition and the Anubhāṣya, 2026)

দুর্গমে কৃষ্ণভাবাব্ধৌ নিমগ্নোন্মগ্নচেতসা ৷
গৌরেণ হরিণা প্রেমমর্য্যাদা ভূরি দর্শিতা ॥ ১ ॥

durgame kṛṣṇa-bhāvābdhau
in the unfathomable of Kṛṣṇa in the ocean of feelings
nimagnonmagna-cetasā
whose heart sank and rose
gaureṇa hariṇā prema-
by Gaura Hari of prema
maryādā bhūri darśitā
the greatness abundantly was shown

1In the unfathomable ocean of feelings for Kṛṣṇa, Gaurahari’s heart now sank and now rose; and so He revealed the greatness of prema in all its fullness.1

জয় জয় শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য অধীশ্বর ৷
জয় নিত্যানন্দ পূর্ণানন্দ-কলেবর ॥ ২ ॥

jaya jaya śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya adhīśvara
glory glory to Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya the Supreme Lord
jaya nityānanda pūrṇānanda-kalevara
glory to Nityānanda full of bliss whose body

2Glory, glory to Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, the Supreme Lord! Glory to Nityānanda, whose body is full of bliss!

জয়াদ্বৈতাচার্য্য কৃষ্ণচৈতন্য-প্রিয়তম ৷
জয় শ্রীবাস-আদি প্রভুর ভক্তগণ ॥ ৩ ॥

jayādvaitācārya kṛṣṇa-caitanya-priyatama
glory to Advaitācārya to Kṛṣṇa Caitanya most dear
jaya śrīvāsa-ādi prabhura bhakta-gaṇa
glory to Śrīvāsa and the others the Lord’s devotees

3Glory to Advaitācārya, most dear to Kṛṣṇa Caitanya! Glory to Śrīvāsa and all the Lord’s devotees!

এইমত মহাপ্রভু রাত্রি-দিবসে ৷
আত্মস্ফূর্ত্তি নাহি কৃষ্ণভাবাবেশে ॥ ৪ ॥

ei-mata mahāprabhu rātri-divase
in this way Mahāprabhu night and day
ātma-sphūrti nāhi kṛṣṇa-bhāvāveśe
of Himself awareness none absorbed in love for Kṛṣṇa

4In this way, night and day, Mahāprabhu was so absorbed in love for Kṛṣṇa that He had no awareness of Himself.

কভু ভাবে মগ্ন, কভু অর্দ্ধ-বাহ্যস্ফূর্ত্তি ৷
কভু বাহ্যস্ফূর্ত্তি, — তিন রীতে প্রভুস্থিতি ॥ ৫ ॥

kabhu bhāve magna, kabhu arddha-bāhya-sphūrti
sometimes in feeling immersed sometimes half external awareness
kabhu bāhya-sphūrti, — tina rīte prabhu-sthiti
sometimes external awareness in three ways the Lord’s state

5Sometimes He was immersed in feeling, sometimes half aware of the outer world, sometimes fully aware of it: the Lord passed through these three states.

স্নান, দর্শন, ভোজন দেহ-স্বভাবে হয় ৷
কুমারের চাক যেন সতত ফিরয় ॥ ৬ ॥

snāna, darśana, bhojana deha-svabhāve haya
bathing seeing the Lord eating by the body’s nature happen
kumārera cāka yena satata phiraya
of the potter the wheel as constantly turns

6Bathing, going to see Lord Jagannātha and eating went on of themselves, by the body’s own nature, as a potter’s wheel keeps turning.2

একদিন করেন প্রভু জগন্নাথ দরশন ৷
জগন্নাথে দেখে সাক্ষাৎ ব্রজেন্দ্রনন্দন ॥ ৭ ॥

ekadina karena prabhu jagannātha daraśana
one day makes the Lord of Jagannātha the seeing
jagannāthe dekhe sākṣāt vrajendra-nandana
in Jagannātha He sees directly the son of the king of Vraja

7One day, when the Lord went to see Lord Jagannātha, He beheld in Him the son of the king of Vraja Himself.

একবারে স্ফুরে প্রভুর কৃষ্ণের পঞ্চগুণ ৷
পঞ্চগুণে করে পঞ্চেন্দ্রিয় আকর্ষণ ॥ ৮ ॥

eka-bāre sphure prabhura kṛṣṇera pañca-guṇa
at once appear to the Lord of Kṛṣṇa five qualities
pañca-guṇe kare pañcendriya ākarṣaṇa
the five qualities make of the five senses attraction

8At once the five qualities of Kṛṣṇa appeared to the Lord, and they drew His five senses to themselves.3

একমন পঞ্চদিকে পঞ্চগুণ টানে ৷
টানাটানি প্রভুর মন হৈল অগেয়ানে ॥ ৯ ॥

ekamana pañca-dike pañca-guṇa ṭāne
one mind in five directions five qualities pull
ṭānāṭāni prabhura mana haila ageyāne
by the tugging the Lord’s mind became unconscious

9The five qualities pulled His one mind in five directions, and, torn this way and that, the Lord lost consciousness.

হেনকালে ঈশ্বরের উপলভোগ সরিল ৷
ভক্তগণ মহাপ্রভুরে ঘরে লঞা আইল ॥ ১০ ॥

hena-kāle īśvarera upala-bhoga sarila
at that time of the Lord the upala-bhoga ended
bhakta-gaṇa mahāprabhure ghare lañā āila
the devotees Mahāprabhu home taking came

10At that time Lord Jagannātha’s upala-bhoga offering came to an end, and the devotees brought Mahāprabhu home.

স্বরূপ, রামানন্দ, — এই দুইজন লঞা ৷
বিলাপ করেন দুঁহার কণ্ঠেতে ধরিয়া ॥ ১১ ॥

svarūpa, rāmānanda, — ei dui-jana lañā
Svarūpa Rāmānanda these two persons with
vilāpa karena dum̐hāra kaṇṭhete dhariyā
lament He makes of both the necks holding

11With these two, Svarūpa and Rāmānanda, He lamented, His arms around their necks.

কৃষ্ণের বিয়োগে রাধার উৎকণ্ঠিত মন ৷
বিশাখারে কহে আপন উৎকণ্ঠা-কারণ ॥ ১২ ॥

kṛṣṇera viyoge rādhāra utkaṇṭhita mana
of Kṛṣṇa in separation Rādhā’s anxious mind
viśākhāre kahe āpana utkaṇṭhā-kāraṇa
to Viśākhā She tells Her own of the longing the cause

12In separation from Kṛṣṇa, Rādhā’s mind was restless with longing, and She told Viśākhā the cause of it.

সেই শ্লোক পড়ি’ আপনে করে মনস্তাপ ৷
শ্লোকের অর্থ শুনায় দুঁহারে করিয়া বিলাপ ॥ ১৩ ॥

sei śloka paḍi’ āpane kare manastāpa
that verse reciting Himself makes heartache
ślokera artha śunāya dum̐hāre kariyā vilāpa
of the verse the meaning makes hear to the two making lament

13Reciting that verse Himself, the Lord poured out the anguish of His heart, and lamenting, He explained its meaning to the two of them.

সৌন্দর্য্যামৃতসিন্ধুভঙ্গললনা-চিত্তাদ্রিসংপ্লাবকঃ
কর্ণানন্দিসনর্ম্মরম্যবচনঃ কোটীন্দুশীতাঙ্গকঃ ৷
সৌরভ্যামৃতসংপ্লবাবৃতজগৎ পীযূষরম্যাধরঃ
শ্রীগোপেন্দ্রসুতঃ স কর্ষতি বলাৎ
পঞ্চেন্দ্রিয়াণ্যালি মে ॥ ১৪ ॥

saundaryāmṛta-sindhu-bhaṅga-
of beauty of the nectar of the ocean by the waves
lalanā-cittādri-saṁplāvakaḥ
of women of the hearts the hills who floods
karṇānandi-sanarma-ramya-
delighting the ears jesting charming
vacanaḥ koṭīndu-śītāṅgakaḥ
whose words than millions of moons cooler whose body
saurabhyāmṛta-saṁplavāvṛta-
of fragrance of nectar by the flood covered
jagat pīyūṣa-ramyādharaḥ
the world than nectar lovelier whose lips
śrī-gopendra-sutaḥ sa karṣati
Śrī of the king of the cowherds the son He draws
balāt pañcendriyāṇy āli me
by force five senses O friend My

14“O friend, with the waves of the nectar ocean of His beauty He floods the hills of women’s hearts; His playful, charming words delight the ear; His body is cooler than millions of moons; with a nectar flood of fragrance He has covered the world; His lips are lovelier than nectar — that son of the king of the cowherds draws all five of My senses by force.” (Govinda-līlāmṛta, 8.3)4

কৃষ্ণ-রূপ-শব্দ-স্পর্শ, সৌরভ্য-অধর-রস,
যার মাধুর্য্য কহন না যায় ৷
দেখি’ লোভে পঞ্চজন, এক অশ্ব — মোর মন,
চড়ি’ পঞ্চ পাঁচদিকে ধায় ॥ ১৫ ॥

kṛṣṇa-rūpa-śabda-sparśa, saurabhya-adhara-rasa,
Kṛṣṇa’s form sound touch fragrance of the lips taste
yāra mādhurya kahana nā yāya
whose sweetness to describe not is possible
dekhi’ lobhe pañcajana,
seeing in greed the five
eka aśva — mora mana,
one horse My mind
caḍi’ pañca pām̐ca-dike dhāya
mounting the five in five directions run

15“Kṛṣṇa’s form, His voice, His touch, His fragrance and the taste of His lips — their sweetness cannot be described. Seeing them, the five, in their greed, mount a single horse — My mind — and ride off in five directions.

সখি হে, শুন মোর দুঃখের কারণ ৷
মোর পঞ্চেন্দ্রিয়গণ, মহা-লম্পট দস্যুগণ,
সবে কহে, — হর’ পরধন ॥ ১৬ ॥

sakhi he, śuna mora duḥkhera kāraṇa
O friend ah hear of My sorrow the cause
mora pañcendriya-gaṇa,
My five senses
mahā-lampaṭa dasyu-gaṇa,
great greedy ones robbers
sabe kahe, — hara’ para-dhana
all say steal another’s wealth

16O friend, hear the cause of My sorrow. My five senses are utterly greedy robbers: they all say, ‘Steal another’s wealth!’5

এক অশ্ব একক্ষণে, পাঁচ পাঁচ দিকে টানে,
এক মন কোন্ দিকে ধায় ?
এককালে সবে টানে, গেল ঘোড়ার পরাণে,
এই দুঃখ সহন না যায় ॥ ১৭ ॥

eka aśva eka-kṣaṇe,
one horse at one moment
pām̐ca pām̐ca dike ṭāne,
the five in five directions pull
eka mana kon dike dhāya?
one mind which way shall run
eka-kāle sabe ṭāne,
at one time all pull
gela ghoḍāra parāṇe,
goes of the horse the life
ei duḥkha sahana nā yāya
this pain to bear not is possible

17One horse, and at one moment the five pull it in five directions — which way is the one mind to run? When all pull at once, the horse’s life departs. I cannot bear this pain.

ইন্দ্রিয়ে না করি রোষ, ইঁহা-সবার কাঁহা দোষ,
কৃষ্ণরূপাদির মহা আকর্ষণ ৷
রূপাদি পাঁচ পাঁচে টানে, গেল ঘোড়ার পরাণে,
মোর দেহে না রহে জীবন ॥ ১৮ ॥

indriye nā kari roṣa,
the senses not I make anger
im̐hā-sabāra kām̐hā doṣa,
of these all where the fault
kṛṣṇa-rūpādira mahā ākarṣaṇa
of Kṛṣṇa’s form and the rest great attraction
rūpādi pām̐ca pām̐ce ṭāne,
form and the rest the five the five pull
gela ghoḍāra parāṇe,
goes of the horse the life
mora dehe nā rahe jīvana
in My body not remains life

18I am not angry with My senses — what fault is theirs? Kṛṣṇa’s form and the rest attract with great force. The five — His form and the rest — pull the five senses; the horse’s life is ebbing, and life will not stay in My body.

কৃষ্ণরূপামৃতসিন্ধু, তাহার তরঙ্গ-বিন্দু,
একবিন্দু জগৎ ডুবায় ৷
ত্রিজগতে যত নারী, তার চিত্ত-উচ্চগিরি,
তাহা ডুবাই আগে উঠি’ ধায় ॥ ১৯ ॥

kṛṣṇa-rūpāmṛta-sindhu,
of Kṛṣṇa’s beauty of nectar the ocean
tāhāra taraṅga-bindu,
of it of a wave a drop
eka-bindu jagat ḍubāya
one drop the world drowns
trijagate yata nārī,
in the three worlds as many as women
tāra citta-ucca-giri,
their hearts high mountains
tāhā ḍubāi āge uṭhi’ dhāya
those drowning further rising rushes

19The beauty of Kṛṣṇa is an ocean of nectar; a single drop of its waves drowns the world. The hearts of all the women in the three worlds are high mountains: it drowns them and surges on beyond.

কৃষ্ণের বচন মাধুরী, নানা-রস-নর্ম্মধারী,
তার অন্যায় কথন না যায় ৷
জগতের নারীর কাণে, মাধুরী গুণে বান্ধি’ টানে,
টানাটানি কাণের প্রাণ যায় ॥ ২০ ॥

kṛṣṇera vacana mādhurī,
Kṛṣṇa’s of the words the sweetness
nānā-rasa-narma-dhārī,
of various rasas jests bearing
tāra anyāya kathana nā yāya
its injustice to describe not is possible
jagatera nārīra kāṇe,
of the world’s women into the ears
mādhurī guṇe bāndhi’ ṭāne,
sweetness with the rope (quality) binding pulls
ṭānāṭāni kāṇera prāṇa yāya
by the tugging of the ears the life departs

20The sweetness of Kṛṣṇa’s words, full of jests in many moods, is unjust beyond telling. Entering the ears of the world’s women, it binds them with the rope of its sweetness and pulls, and in that tug-of-war the ears lose their very life.6

কৃষ্ণ-অঙ্গ সুশীতল, কি কহিমু তার বল,
ছটায় জিনে কোটীন্দু চন্দন ৷
সশৈল নারীর বক্ষ, তাহা আকর্ষিতে দক্ষ,
আকর্ষয়ে নারীগণ-মন ॥ ২১ ॥

kṛṣṇa-aṅga suśītala,
Kṛṣṇa’s body very cool
ki kahimu tāra bala,
what shall I say its power
chaṭāya jine koṭīndu candana
by its lustre conquers millions of moons sandal
saśaila nārīra vakṣa,
mountain-like of women the breasts
tāhā ākarṣite dakṣa,
those in drawing skilled
ākarṣaye nārī-gaṇa-mana
draws of the women the minds

21Kṛṣṇa’s body is so cool — what can I say of its power? With its rays it surpasses millions of moons and sandal paste. Skilled at drawing the mountain-like breasts of women, it draws their minds as well.

কৃষ্ণাঙ্গ — সৌরভ্যভর, মৃগমদ মনোহর,
নীলোৎপলের হরে গর্ব্ব-ধন ৷
জগৎ-নারীর নাসা, তার ভিতর পাতে বাসা,
নারীগণে করে আকর্ষণ ॥ ২২ ॥

kṛṣṇāṅga — saurabhya-bhara,
Kṛṣṇa’s body of fragrance full
mṛga-mada manohara,
musk charming
nīlotpalera hare garva-dhana
of the blue lotus steals of pride the wealth
jagat-nārīra nāsā,
of the world’s women the nostrils
tāra bhitara pāte vāsā,
of them inside makes a dwelling
nārī-gaṇe kare ākarṣaṇa
the women makes attraction

22Kṛṣṇa’s body is laden with fragrance; it humbles charming musk and robs the blue lotus of its wealth of pride. It makes its home in the nostrils of the world’s women and draws them to itself.

কৃষ্ণের অধরামৃত, তাতে কর্পূর-মন্দস্মিত,
স্ব-মাধুর্য্যে হরে নারীর মন ৷
অন্যত্র ছাড়ায় লোভ, না পাইলে মনে ক্ষোভ,
ব্রজনারীগণের মূলধন ॥ ২৩ ॥

kṛṣṇera adharāmṛta,
Kṛṣṇa’s the nectar of the lips
tāte karpūra-manda-smita,
with it camphor gentle smile
sva-mādhurye hare nārīra mana
by its own sweetness steals of women the mind
anyatra chāḍāya lobha,
elsewhere takes away the longing
nā pāile mane kṣobha,
not having obtained in the mind agitation
vraja-nārī-gaṇera mūla-dhana
of Vraja’s women the principal wealth

23The nectar of Kṛṣṇa’s lips, with the camphor of His gentle smile, steals women’s minds by its own sweetness. It takes away all longing for anything else; not obtaining it, the mind is in turmoil. It is the chief wealth of the women of Vraja.”

এত কহি’ গৌরহরি, দুইজনার কণ্ঠ ধরি’,
কহে, — শুন, স্বরূপ-রামরায় ৷
কাঁহা কঁরো, কাঁহা যাঙ, কাঁহা গেলে কৃষ্ণ পাঙ,
দুঁহে মোরে কহ সে উপায় ॥ ২৪ ॥

eta kahi’ gaurahari,
so saying Gaurahari
dui-janāra kaṇṭha dhari’,
of the two the necks holding
kahe, — śuna, svarūpa-rāmarāya
says hear Svarūpa Rāmarāya
kām̐hā kam̐ro, kām̐hā yāṅa,
what shall I do where shall I go
kām̐hā gele kṛṣṇa pāṅa,
where going Kṛṣṇa shall I find
dum̐he more kaha se upāya
you two to Me tell that means

24Saying this, Gaurahari threw His arms around the necks of the two and said, “Listen, Svarūpa and Rāmarāya: what shall I do, where shall I go? Where can I go to find Kṛṣṇa? Both of you, tell Me how!”

এইমত গৌরপ্রভু প্রতিদিনে-দিনে ৷
বিলাপ করেন স্বরূপ-রামানন্দ-সনে ॥ ২৫ ॥

ei-mata gaura-prabhu prati dine-dine
in this way Gaura the Lord every day after day
vilāpa karena svarūpa-rāmānanda-sane
lament makes with Svarūpa and Rāmānanda

25In this way, day after day, the Lord Gaura lamented with Svarūpa and Rāmānanda.

সেই দুইজন প্রভুরে করে আশ্বাসন ৷
স্বরূপ গায়, রায় করে শ্লোক পঠন ॥ ২৬ ॥

sei dui-jana prabhure kare āśvāsana
those two persons the Lord make consolation
svarūpa gāya, rāya kare śloka paṭhana
Svarūpa sings Rāya makes of verses recitation

26Those two consoled the Lord: Svarūpa sang songs, and Rāya recited verses.

কর্ণামৃত, বিদ্যাপতি, শ্রীগীতগোবিন্দ ৷
ইহার শ্লোক-গীতে প্রভুর করায় আনন্দ ॥ ২৭ ॥

karṇāmṛta, vidyāpati, śrī-gīta-govinda
Karṇāmṛta Vidyāpati Śrī Gīta-govinda
ihāra śloka-gīte prabhura karāya ānanda
of these in verses and songs to the Lord give joy

27With the verses and songs of the Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta, of Vidyāpati and of the Śrī Gīta-govinda they gave the Lord joy.

একদিন মহাপ্রভু সমুদ্র যাইতে ৷
পুষ্পের উদ্যান তথা দেখেন আচম্বিতে ॥ ২৮ ॥

ekadina mahāprabhu samudra yāite
one day Mahāprabhu to the sea going
puṣpera udyāna tathā dekhena ācambite
of flowers a garden there sees suddenly

28One day, on His way to the sea, Mahāprabhu suddenly saw a flower garden.

বৃন্দাবন-ভ্রমে তাঁহা পশিলা ধাঞা ৷
প্রেমাবেশে বুলে তাঁহা কৃষ্ণ অন্বেষিয়া ॥ ২৯ ॥

vṛndāvana-bhrame tām̐hā paśilā dhāñā
Vṛndāvana mistaking it for there entered running
premāveśe bule tām̐hā kṛṣṇa anveṣiyā
absorbed in prema wanders there Kṛṣṇa searching for

29Taking it for Vṛndāvana, He ran into it, and absorbed in prema He wandered there searching for Kṛṣṇa,

রাসে রাধা লঞা কৃষ্ণ অন্তর্দ্ধান কৈলা ৷
পাছে সখীগণ যৈছে চাহি’ বেড়াইলা ॥ ৩০ ॥

rāse rādhā lañā kṛṣṇa antarddhāna kailā
in the rāsa Rādhā taking Kṛṣṇa disappearance made
pāche sakhī-gaṇa yaiche cāhi’ beḍāilā
afterwards the gopīs as searching wandered

30just as, when Kṛṣṇa disappeared from the rāsa dance taking Rādhā with Him, the gopīs afterwards wandered about searching for Him.

সেই ভাবাবেশে প্রভু প্রতি-তরুলতা ৷
শ্লোক পড়ি’ পড়ি’ চাহি’ বুলে যথা তথা ॥ ৩১ ॥

sei bhāvāveśe prabhu prati-taru-latā
in that mood absorbed the Lord each tree creeper
śloka paḍi’ paḍi’ cāhi’ bule yathā tathā
verses reciting reciting searching wanders here there

31Absorbed in that mood, the Lord wandered here and there searching, reciting verse after verse to each tree and creeper:

চূতপ্রিয়ালপনসাসনকোবিদার-
জম্ব্বর্কবিল্ববকুলাম্রকদম্বনীপাঃ ৷
যেঽন্যে পরার্থভবকা যমুনোপকূলাঃ
শংসন্তু কৃষ্ণপদবীং রহিতাত্মনাং নঃ ॥ ৩২ ॥

cūta-priyāla-panasāsana-kovidāra-
cūta priyāla panasa āsana kovidāra
jambv-arka-bilva-bakulāmra-kadamba-nīpāḥ
jambu arka bilva bakula mango kadamba nīpa
ye ’nye parārtha-bhavakā yamunopakūlāḥ
who other for others’ good born on the Yamunā’s banks
śaṁsantu kṛṣṇa-padavīṁ rahitātmanāṁ naḥ
tell of Kṛṣṇa the path who have lost our selves to us

32“O cūta, priyāla, panasa, āsana and kovidāra, jambu, arka, bilva, bakula, mango, kadamba and nīpa, and all you other trees on the banks of the Yamunā, whose life is for the good of others — tell us, who have lost our very selves, which way Kṛṣṇa went!” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 10.30.9)

কচ্চিত্তুলসি কল্যাণি গোবিন্দচরণপ্রিয়ে ৷
সহ ত্বালিকুলৈর্বিভ্রদ্দৃষ্টস্তেঽতিপ্রিয়োঽচ্যুতঃ ॥ ৩৩ ॥

kaccit tulasi kalyāṇi
perhaps O tulasī O auspicious one
govinda-caraṇa-priye
to Govinda’s feet dear
saha tvāli-kulair bibhrad
with you by swarms of bees bearing
dṛṣṭas te ’ti-priyo ’cyutaḥ
seen your very dear Acyuta

33“O auspicious tulasī, dear to Govinda’s feet! Have you seen Acyuta, who holds you so dear, pass by wearing you, with swarms of bees around Him?” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 10.30.7)

মালত্যদর্শি বঃ কচ্চিন্মল্লিকে জাতি যূথিকে ৷
প্রীতিং বো জনয়ন্ যাতঃ করস্পর্শেন মাধবঃ ॥ ৩৪ ॥

mālaty adarśi vaḥ kaccin
O mālatī was seen by you perhaps
mallike jāti yūthike
O mallikā O jāti O yūthikā
prītiṁ vo janayan yātaḥ
joy your producing gone
kara-sparśena mādhavaḥ
by the touch of His hand Mādhava

34“O mālatī, O mallikā, O jāti, O yūthikā! Have you seen Mādhava pass by, giving you joy with the touch of His hand?” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 10.30.8)

আম্র, পনস, পিয়াল, জম্বু, কোবিদার ৷
তীর্থবাসী সবে, কর পর-উপকার ॥ ৩৫ ॥

āmra, panasa, piyāla, jambu, kovidāra
O mango panasa piyāla jambu kovidāra
tīrtha-vāsī sabe, kara para-upakāra
of a holy place dwellers all do to others good

35“O mango, panasa, piyāla, jambu and kovidāra! You all dwell in a holy place — so do good to others.7

কৃষ্ণ তোমার ইঁহা আইলা, পাইলা দরশন ?
কৃষ্ণের উদ্দেশ কহি’ রাখহ জীবন ॥ ৩৬ ॥

kṛṣṇa tomāra im̐hā āilā, pāilā daraśana?
Kṛṣṇa to you here came did you have sight of Him
kṛṣṇera uddeśa kahi’ rākhaha jīvana
of Kṛṣṇa the whereabouts telling save our lives

36Did Kṛṣṇa come here to you? Did you see Him? Tell us where Kṛṣṇa is and save our lives!”

উত্তর না পাঞা পুনঃ করে অনুমান ৷
এইসব — পুরুষ-জাতি, কৃষ্ণের সখার সমান ॥ ৩৭ ॥

uttara nā pāñā punaḥ kare anumāna
an answer not getting again they make a surmise
eisaba — puruṣa-jāti, kṛṣṇera sakhāra samāna
all these male in kind of Kṛṣṇa friends like

37Receiving no answer, they reasoned again: “These are all male, just like Kṛṣṇa’s friends.

এ কেনে কহিবে কৃষ্ণের উদ্দেশ আমায় ?
এ — স্ত্রীজাতি লতা, আমার সখীপ্রায় ॥ ৩৮ ॥

e kene kahibe kṛṣṇera uddeśa āmāya?
these why will tell of Kṛṣṇa the whereabouts to us
e — strī-jāti latā, āmāra sakhī-prāya
these female in kind creepers our friends almost

38Why would they tell us where Kṛṣṇa is? But these creepers are female, almost our friends.

অবশ্য কহিবে, — পাঞাছে কৃষ্ণের দর্শনে ৷
এত অনুমানি’ পুছে তুলস্যাদি-গণে ॥ ৩৯ ॥

avaśya kahibe, — pāñāche kṛṣṇera darśane
surely they will tell they have had of Kṛṣṇa the sight
eta anumāni’ puche tulasyādi-gaṇe
thus reasoning they ask tulasī and the others

39They will surely tell us — they have seen Kṛṣṇa.” Reasoning thus, they questioned the tulasī and the other plants:

তুলসি, মালতি, যূথি, মাধবি, মল্লিকে ৷
তোমার প্রিয় কৃষ্ণ আইলা তোমার অন্তিকে ? ॥ ৪০ ॥

tulasi, mālati, yūthi, mādhavi, mallike
O tulasī O mālatī O yūthī O mādhavī O mallikā
tomāra priya kṛṣṇa āilā tomāra antike?
your beloved Kṛṣṇa came your near

40“O tulasī, mālatī, yūthī, mādhavī and mallikā! Did your beloved Kṛṣṇa come near you?

তুমি-সব — হও আমার সখীর সমান ৷
কৃষ্ণোদ্দেশ কহি’ সবে রাখহ পরাণ ॥ ৪১ ॥

tumi-saba — hao āmāra sakhīra samāna
you all are our friends like
kṛṣṇoddeśa kahi’ sabe rākhaha parāṇa
Kṛṣṇa’s whereabouts telling all of you save our lives

41You are all like our friends. Tell us where Kṛṣṇa is, all of you, and save our lives!”

উত্তর না পাঞা পুনঃ ভাবেন অন্তরে ৷
এহ — কৃষ্ণদাসী, ভয়ে না কহে আমারে ॥ ৪২ ॥

uttara nā pāñā punaḥ bhāvena antare
an answer not getting again they think within
eha — kṛṣṇa-dāsī, bhaye nā kahe āmāre
these Kṛṣṇa’s maidservants out of fear not tell us

42Receiving no answer, they thought within themselves: “These are Kṛṣṇa’s maidservants; out of fear they will not tell us.”

আগে মৃগীগণ দেখি’ কৃষ্ণাঙ্গগন্ধ পাঞা ৷
তার মুখ দেখি’ পুছেন নির্ণয় করিয়া ॥ ৪৩ ॥

āge mṛgī-gaṇa dekhi’ kṛṣṇāṅga-gandha pāñā
ahead does seeing of Kṛṣṇa’s body the fragrance catching
tāra mukha dekhi’ puchena nirṇaya kariyā
their faces looking at they ask certainty making

43Ahead they saw some does, and catching the fragrance of Kṛṣṇa’s body, they looked at their faces and, now certain, questioned them:

অপ্যেণ-পত্ন্যুপগতঃ প্রিয়য়েহ গাত্রৈ-
স্তন্বন্ দৃশাং সখি সুনির্ব্বৃতিমচ্যুতো বঃ ৷
কান্তাঙ্গসঙ্গকুচকুঙ্কুম-রঞ্জিতায়াঃ
কুন্দস্রজঃ কুলপতেরিহ বাতি গন্ধঃ ॥ ৪৪ ॥

apy eṇa-patny upagataḥ priyayeha gātrais
perhaps O doe came with His beloved here with His limbs
tanvan dṛśāṁ sakhi su-nirvṛtim acyuto vaḥ
expanding of the eyes O friend the great joy Acyuta your
kāntāṅga-saṅga-kuca-kuṅkuma-rañjitāyāḥ
of the beloved’s body from contact of the breasts with kuṅkuma coloured
kunda-srajaḥ kula-pater iha vāti gandhaḥ
of the kunda garland of our Lord here blows the fragrance

44“O friend, O doe, did Acyuta come this way with His beloved, delighting your eyes with the beauty of His limbs? For here blows the fragrance of our Lord’s kunda garland, reddened with kuṅkuma from His beloved’s breasts as He held Her close.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 10.30.11)8

কহ, মৃগি, রাধা-সহ শ্রীকৃষ্ণ সর্ব্বথা ৷
তোমায় সুখ দিতে আইলা? না কহ অন্যথা ॥ ৪৫ ॥

kaha, mṛgi, rādhā-saha śrī-kṛṣṇa sarvathā
tell O doe with Rādhā Śrī Kṛṣṇa in every way
tomāya sukha dite āilā? nā kaha anyathā
to you joy to give did He come not say otherwise

45“Tell us, O doe: did Śrī Kṛṣṇa come here with Rādhā to give you every joy? Do not tell us otherwise.

রাধা-প্রিয়সখী আমরা, নহি বহিরঙ্গ ৷
দূর হৈতে জানি তার যৈছে অঙ্গ-গন্ধ ॥ ৪৬ ॥

rādhā-priya-sakhī āmarā, nahi bahiraṅga
Rādhā’s dear friends we are not outsiders
dūra haite jāni tāra yaiche aṅga-gandha
from far away we know His what kind body’s fragrance

46We are Rādhā’s dear friends, not outsiders; even from afar we know the fragrance of His body.

রাধা-অঙ্গ-সঙ্গে কুচকুঙ্কুম-ভূষিত ৷
কৃষ্ণ-কুন্দমালা-গন্ধে বায়ু — সুবাসিত ॥ ৪৭ ॥

rādhā-aṅga-saṅge kuca-kuṅkuma-bhūṣita
with Rādhā’s body by contact with the breasts’ kuṅkuma adorned
kṛṣṇa-kunda-mālā-gandhe vāyu — suvāsita
Kṛṣṇa’s kunda garland with the fragrance the air is scented

47The air is scented with the fragrance of Kṛṣṇa’s kunda garland, adorned with kuṅkuma from Rādhā’s breasts as He embraced Her.

কৃষ্ণ ইঁহা ছাড়ি’ গেলা, ইঁহ — বিরহিণী ৷
কিবা উত্তর দিবে এই, না শুনে কাহিনী ॥ ৪৮ ॥

kṛṣṇa im̐hā chāḍi’ gelā, im̐ha — virahiṇī
Kṛṣṇa here leaving went this one pining in separation
kibā uttara dibe ei, nā śune kāhinī
what answer will give she not hears our words

48Kṛṣṇa has left this place, and she is pining in separation. What answer can she give? She does not even hear our words.”

আগে বৃক্ষগণ দেখে পুষ্পফলভরে ৷
শাখা সব পড়িয়াছে পৃথিবী-উপরে ॥ ৪৯ ॥

āge vṛkṣa-gaṇa dekhe puṣpa-phala-bhare
ahead trees they see of flowers and fruits under the weight
śākhā saba paḍiyāche pṛthivī-upare
branches all have fallen the earth upon

49Ahead they saw trees whose branches had all bent down to the earth under the weight of flowers and fruits.

কৃষ্ণে দেখি’ এই সব করেন নমস্কার ৷
কৃষ্ণগমন পুছে তারে করিয়া নির্দ্ধার ॥ ৫০ ॥

kṛṣṇe dekhi’ ei saba karena namaskāra
Kṛṣṇa seeing these all make obeisance
kṛṣṇa-gamana puche tāre kariyā nirddhāra
Kṛṣṇa’s going they ask them certainty making

50Concluding that all these trees had bowed down on seeing Kṛṣṇa, they asked them, to be sure, which way He had gone:

বাহুং প্রিয়াংস উপধায় গৃহীতপদ্মো
রামানুজস্তুলসিকালিকুলৈর্মদান্ধৈঃ ৷
অন্বীয়মান ইহ বস্তরবঃ প্রণামং
কিংবাভিনন্দতি চরন্ প্রণয়াবলোকৈঃ ॥ ৫১ ॥

bāhuṁ priyāṁsa upadhāya gṛhīta-padmo
the arm on His beloved’s shoulder placing holding a lotus
rāmānujas tulasikāli-kulair madāndhaiḥ
Rāma’s younger brother by the tulasī bees in swarms blind with intoxication
anvīyamāna iha vas taravaḥ praṇāmaṁ
followed here your O trees obeisance
kiṁ vābhinandati caran praṇayāvalokaiḥ
whether welcomes passing with loving glances

51“O trees, did Rāma’s younger brother pass this way, His arm on His beloved’s shoulder and a lotus in His hand, followed by swarms of bees from His tulasī garland, blind with intoxication? And as He passed, did He welcome your obeisances with loving glances?” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 10.30.12)9

প্রিয়া-মুখে ভৃঙ্গ পড়ে, তাহা নিবারিতে ৷
লীলাপদ্ম চালাইতে হৈল অন্যচিত্তে ॥ ৫২ ॥

priyā-mukhe bhṛṅga paḍe, tāhā nivārite
of the beloved on the face bees fall them to drive away
līlā-padma cālāite haila anya-citte
the pastime lotus in waving became of distracted mind

52As bees settled on His beloved’s face, He waved His pastime lotus to drive them away, and His mind was distracted.

তোমার প্রণামে কি কৈরাছেন অবধান ?
কিবা নাহি করেন, কহ বচন প্রমাণ ॥ ৫৩ ॥

tomāra praṇāme ki kairāchena avadhāna?
your obeisance whether did He pay attention
kibā nāhi karena, kaha vacana pramāṇa
or not did He tell word as proof

53Did He pay any attention to your obeisances, or did He not? Tell us — give us your word as proof.

কৃষ্ণের বিয়োগে এই সেবক দুঃখিত ৷
কিবা উত্তর দিবে, ইহার নাহিক সম্বিৎ ॥ ৫৪ ॥

kṛṣṇera viyoge ei sevaka duḥkhita
of Kṛṣṇa in separation these servants grieving
kibā uttara dibe, ihāra nāhika samvit
what answer will they give their is not consciousness

54These servants are grieving in separation from Kṛṣṇa. What answer can they give? They are not even conscious.”

এত বলি’ আগে চলে যমুনার কূলে ৷
দেখে, — তাঁহা কৃষ্ণ হয় কদম্বের তলে ॥ ৫৫ ॥

eta bali’ āge cale yamunāra kūle
so saying further they go of the Yamunā to the bank
dekhe, — tām̐hā kṛṣṇa haya kadambera tale
they see there Kṛṣṇa is of a kadamba beneath

55Saying this, they went on to the bank of the Yamunā, and there they saw Kṛṣṇa beneath a kadamba tree.

কোটিমন্মথমোহন মুরলী-বদন ৷
অপার সৌন্দর্য্যে হরে জগন্নেত্র-মন ॥ ৫৬ ॥

koṭi-manmatha-mohana muralī-vadana
millions of gods of love enchanting with the flute at His lips
apāra saundarye hare jagan-netra-mana
boundless by beauty steals the world’s eyes and mind

56He enchants millions of gods of love; the flute is at His lips; with His boundless beauty He steals the eyes and minds of the whole world.

সৌন্দর্য্য দেখিয়া ভূমে পড়ে মূর্চ্ছা পাঞা ৷
হেনকালে স্বরূপাদি মিলিলা আসিয়া ॥ ৫৭ ॥

saundarya dekhiyā bhūme paḍe mūrcchā pāñā
the beauty seeing to the ground falls a swoon getting
hena-kāle svarūpādi mililā āsiyā
at that time Svarūpa and the others met arriving

স্বরূপ-গোসাঞিরে কহেন, — গাও এক গীত ৷

in the rāsa Hari here who enjoyed pastimes
smarati mano mama kṛta-parihāsam
remembers mind My who made jests

svarūpa-gosāñi yabe ei pada gāhilā
Svarūpa Gosāñi when this song sang

85When Svarūpa Gosāñi sang this song, the Lord rose, absorbed in prema, and began to dance.

‘অষ্টসাত্ত্বিক’ ভাব অঙ্গে প্রকট হইল ৷

পুনঃ পুনঃ আস্বাদয়ে, করেন নর্ত্তন ॥ ৮৮ ॥

88Again and again He had that song sung; again and again He relished it and danced.

এইমত নৃত্য যদি হইল বহুক্ষণ ৷
স্বরূপ-গোসাঞি পদ কৈলা সমাপন ॥ ৮৯ ॥

ei-mata nṛtya yadi haila bahu-kṣaṇa

svarūpa-gosāñi pada kailā samāpana

89When the dancing had gone on in this way for a long time, Svarūpa Gosāñi brought the song to a close.

sing sing saying the Lord says again and again

not sings Svarūpa Gosāñi fatigue seeing His

‘বল্’ ‘বল্’ প্রভু বলেন, ভক্তগণ শুনি’ ৷
চৌদিকেতে সবে মেলি’ করে হরিধ্বনি ॥ ৯১ ॥

vyajanādi kari’ prabhura śrama ghucāilā

92Then Rāmānanda Rāya made the Lord sit down and relieved His fatigue by fanning Him and serving Him in other ways.

স্নান করাঞা পুনঃ তাঁরে লঞা আইলা ঘরে ॥ ৯৩ ॥

93Then they took the Lord to the seashore, bathed Him, and brought Him home again.

রামানন্দ-আদি সবে গেলা নিজ-স্থান ॥ ৯৪ ॥

bhojana karāñā prabhure karāilā śayana
meal making Him take the Lord made lie down

94They gave the Lord His meal and had Him lie down to rest, and Rāmānanda and all the others went to their own places.

বৃন্দাবন ভ্রমে যাঁহা প্রবেশ তাঁহার ॥ ৯৫ ॥

ei ta’ kahilum̐ prabhura udyāna-vihāra

vṛndāvana bhrame yām̐hā praveśa tām̐hāra
Vṛndāvana mistaking it for where the entering His

95Thus I have told of the Lord’s pastime in the garden that He entered, taking it for Vṛndāvana.22

বিলাপ-সহিত এই উন্মাদ-বর্ণন ৷
শ্রীরূপ-গোসাঞি ইহা কৈরাছেন লিখন ॥ ৯৬ ॥

vilāpa-sahita ei unmāda-varṇana
with lament together this of madness description
śrī-rūpa-gosāñi ihā kairāchena likhana
Śrī Rūpa Gosāñi this has made writing

96Śrī Rūpa Gosāñi too has described this divine madness of the Lord, together with His lament:

পয়োরাশেস্তীরে স্ফুরদুপবনালীকলনয়া
মুহুর্বৃন্দারণ্যস্মরণজনিতপ্রেমবিবশঃ ৷
ক্বচিৎ কৃষ্ণাবৃত্তিপ্রচলরসনো ভক্তিরসিকঃ
স চৈতন্যঃ কিং মে পুনরপি দৃশোর্যাস্যতি পদম্ ॥ ৯৭ ॥

payo-rāśes tīre sphurad-
of the ocean on the shore gleaming
upavanālī-kalanayā
of rows of gardens by the sight
muhur vṛndāraṇya-smaraṇa-janita-
again and again of the Vṛndāvana forest by remembrance born
prema-vivaśaḥ
by prema overwhelmed
kvacit kṛṣṇāvṛtti-pracala-
sometimes of Kṛṣṇa’s name by repetition restless
rasano bhakti-rasikaḥ
whose tongue of bhakti the relisher
sa caitanyaḥ kiṁ me punar api
that Caitanya will my again even
dṛśor yāsyati padam
of the eyes come to the path

97“At times, on the shore of the ocean, at the sight of rows of gleaming gardens, He would remember again and again the forest of Vṛndāvana and be overwhelmed by the prema it awakened, His tongue moving restlessly as it repeated Kṛṣṇa’s name. Will that Caitanya, the relisher of bhakti, come once again before my eyes?” (Stava-mālā, First Caitanyāṣṭaka, 6)23

অনন্ত চৈতন্যলীলা না যায় লিখন ৷
দিঙ্মাত্র দেখাঞা তাহা করিয়ে সূচন ॥ ৯৮ ॥

ananta caitanya-līlā nā yāya likhana
endless Caitanya’s pastimes not can be written
diṅ-mātra dekhāñā tāhā kariye sūcana
a mere direction showing them I make indication

98Śrī Caitanya’s pastimes are endless; they cannot all be written. I only point the way and give a hint of them.

শ্রীরূপ-রঘুনাথ-পদে যার আশ ৷
চৈতন্যচরিতামৃত কহে কৃষ্ণদাস ॥ ৯৯ ॥

śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa
Śrī Rūpa’s, Raghunātha’s at the feet whose hope
caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
“Caitanya-caritāmṛta” narrates Kṛṣṇadāsa

99Praying at the feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate the Caitanya-caritāmṛta.

✦

Notes

  1. Anubhāṣya: the ocean of feelings for Kṛṣṇa is unfathomable even for sages headed by Brahmā, for their knowledge rests on the senses. Heading in the edition: the Lord is immersed in the ocean of the mahābhāva of separation from Kṛṣṇa.
  2. Anubhāṣya: a potter’s wheel goes on turning by the force of the first push, and the potter need not keep his hand on it; so the Lord’s bodily actions went on naturally even when He had no awareness of the outer world. The comparison fits the daily life of the highest mahā-bhāgavata as long as he remains in this world.
  3. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: His form draws the eyes, His song the ears, His fragrance the nose, His taste the tongue and His touch the skin; all five transcendental qualities of Kṛṣṇa appeared at once to the Lord’s five transcendental senses.
  4. Heading in the edition: Śrī Rādhā’s words to Viśākhā.
  5. Anubhāṣya: drawn by Kṛṣṇa, the senses conspire like five robbers: “Come, let us steal this wealth that belongs to another — the horse of the mind.” Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: the senses know that Kṛṣṇa is another’s man, and still each seeks to steal its own object in Him.
  6. Guṇa means both “quality” and “rope”: sweetness binds the ears as with a rope. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: Kṛṣṇa’s playful speech treats women so unjustly that words cannot tell it.
  7. Heading in the edition: the meaning of the verse; the gopīs, wholly absorbed in Kṛṣṇa and separated from Him, search for Him and lament.
  8. The edition prints sakhī (a misprint; the vocative is sakhi, as in the Anubhāṣya: he sakhi). In the verse the beloved is not named; that She is Rādhā is said in verses 45–47 and in the Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya.
  9. Anubhāṣya: His left arm rests on His beloved’s shoulder, and in His right hand He holds a lotus for play; the bees are blind with the intoxication of the nectar they have drunk.
  10. Anubhāṣya: tāra-hāra — a necklace shining like bright stars. He is Madana, who intoxicates: to nourish the rasa of meeting He makes the beloved pine in separation and then makes the meeting fuller; and He is Mohana, who enchants by both — hence Madana-mohana.
  11. Anubhāṣya: joy, because He hears of Kṛṣṇa’s sweetness; sorrow, because He is separated from Him.
  12. The verse is Madhya 24.48; translated as there.
  13. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: Kṛṣṇa has set the snare of His face to catch the does — the gopīs — and laid in it the bait of His sweet smile. The edition reads mukha phānda (no hyphen).
  14. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: “Ah, our friend Śrī Kṛṣṇa behaves just like a hunter!” These are words of loving reproach.
  15. Anubhāṣya: Lakṣmī is a golden line on the left side of the chest; Śrīvatsa is a mark on the right side, a curl of hair turning to the right.
  16. The Gauḍīya Maṭha edition reads mane, “in the mind” (other editions mare, “die”). Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: from the poison of this bite — His touch — the gopī burns with the fever of love’s desire.
  17. The first line is the same as Madhya 2.34; translated as there. Anubhāṣya: veṇā-mūla is the fragrant khaskhas root (vetiver).
  18. Heading in the edition: Śrī Rādhā’s words to Viśākhā — Her longing to see Kṛṣṇa.
  19. Anubhāṣya: Keśava is He who brings under His sway ka and īśa — Brahmā and Śiva.
  20. Anubhāṣya: saṁvit — when a troubled mind regains steady awareness.
  21. Anubhāṣya: bhāvodaya — the rise of the eight sāttvika-bhāvas; bhāva-sandhi — the meeting of two feelings, alike or different; bhāva-śābalya — the clash of many feelings with one another.
  22. Heading in the edition: the Lord’s divine madness (udghūrṇā and citra-jalpa): thinking Himself a maidservant of the gopīs, He remembers the pastimes of Vṛndāvana.
  23. The last line is the same as Ādi 3.65 (Caitanyāṣṭaka, 1). Anubhāṣya: rows of gardens gleaming with beauty on the sandy shore of the ocean; His tongue is restless with the ceaseless kīrtana of the name “Kṛṣṇa”.
